title: The Bakery of Rosewater Lane
author: Astrid Winterbourne
blurb: Sebastian Marchetti, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
